_comment: Payloads the oracle-leak assertion MUST abort on. Each is a route ground truth could actually travel by. A string prefixed 'AGENT:' is loaded as redact.AgentText — content the agent or a tool produced — and the prefix is stripped. Everything else is harness-authored.
